goals.description: Validate pipeline outputs and review artifacts using MLTE evidence validators

metrics.description: Status output, log output, explanation image, and structured review evidence meet validation expectations

system.task: Classify inspection inputs and report validation behavior
system.usage_context: The model runs inside an inspection pipeline that must return clear status values, useful logs, and reviewable evidence artifacts
risks: Invalid inputs may not be handled consistently
Diagnostic logs may not contain the required error tag
Reviewers may not receive useful explanation evidence
Structured error-pattern evidence may be hard to inspect

data.purpose: Testing output validation and review evidence behavior

fields.name: inspection input
fields.description: Input record or image path sent to the inspection pipeline
fields.expected_values: valid image path or invalid input marker

model.capability_deployment_mechanism: The model is called by a validation pipeline that records output status, diagnostic logs, and review evidence

input_specification.name: inspection input
input_specification.expected_values: valid image path or invalid input marker

output_specification.name: explanation image
output_specification.description: Image artifact showing the regions used by the model

output_specification.name: class error evidence
output_specification.description: Structured evidence describing class-level error patterns

system_requirements.stimulus: The pipeline receives an invalid inspection input
system_requirements.response: The pipeline returns a status output
system_requirements.measure: the status output is exactly INVALID_INPUT

system_requirements.stimulus: The pipeline receives an invalid inspection input
system_requirements.response: The pipeline records a diagnostic log entry
system_requirements.measure: the diagnostic log contains the text Model - Input Validation Error

system_requirements.stimulus: The model receives a valid inspection image
system_requirements.response: The pipeline provides an explanation image for human review
system_requirements.measure: reviewers can inspect the image artifact to see the regions used by the model

system_requirements.stimulus: The evaluation pipeline completes classification testing
system_requirements.response: The pipeline provides structured class-level error evidence
system_requirements.measure: reviewers can inspect the structured evidence to understand class-level error patterns
